title: E-Learning Management System (LMS)
description: A comprehensive E-Learning platform for course material and user role management, achieving 100% UAT compliance. The project was led and designed using MVC architecture and Agile Scrum methodologies.

title: Bensin-API
description: A public API that normalizes and provides national Pertamina fuel price data. The data is automatically fetched, normalized (reducing payload size by ~43%), and updated hourly from the upstream source using a cron job in a GitHub Actions CI/CD pipeline.

title: Restaurant POS & Kitchen Display System
description: An offline-first Point of Sale system developed specifically for restaurants. It features a robust NestJS backend and a Tauri desktop app for the frontend, complete with Floor Plan management, real-time Kitchen Display System (KDS) via WebSockets, and secure Role-Based Access Control (RBAC).

title: Nanasgunung Content Planner
description: A SaaS platform designed for social media content planning automation. It features a custom rich-text editor and integrates AI models to automatically generate content drafts (hooks, captions, outlines).

title: OtoNotif – Vehicle Health Tracker
description: A comprehensive vehicle health monitoring dashboard to log fuel fill-ups, odometer readings, and service history. It features real-time condition tracking to notify users when components approach their wear limits. Deployed using containerized architecture.

title: Kaslo – Personal Finance Management
description: A serverless Personal Finance Management (PFM) web application for tracking transactions, inter-account transfers, and monthly financial analytics. Fully optimized as a Progressive Web App (PWA) using Serwist, featuring runtime caching and offline-fallback capabilities.
